Summary: EPIC: Workflow Automation & Exception Handling
Description: Comprehensive enhancements to core attendance lifecycle including emergency amendment and standardized reason taxonomy.
Acceptance Criteria: All workflow sub-tasks implemented with 100% test coverage

Summary: EPIC: Teacher & Admin UI/UX Streamlining
Description: UI/UX productivity upgrades including 1-click bulk roll-call, interactive confirmation modals, and Khmer/English localization.
Acceptance Criteria: Seamless usability on desktop and mobile with KH/EN locale switching

Summary: EPIC: Advanced Analytics & Multi-Format Reporting
Description: Multi-dimensional reporting across custom date ranges (weekly, monthly, semester), class/student filters, and Excel/PDF generation.
Acceptance Criteria: Instant report downloads in CSV, XLSX, and printable PDF

Summary: EPIC: Performance, Redis Caching & Queue Architecture
Description: Backend query optimization, N+1 elimination, composite database indexing, and asynchronous Redis queue worker for audit logging.
Acceptance Criteria: Response times under 50ms for 500+ concurrent requests

Summary: EPIC: Enterprise Security, RBAC & Multi-Tenant Governance
Description: Hardening of authentication, two-factor authentication (2FA), password rotation, secure evidence file uploads, and session timeouts.
Acceptance Criteria: Meets enterprise data privacy and security audit standards

Summary: EPIC: Omnichannel Parent Notifications & Mobile API
Description: Automated instant alerts via Telegram Bot / SMS when a student is absent or late, plus Laravel Sanctum REST API for mobile apps.
Acceptance Criteria: Real-time parent dispatch within 10 seconds of attendance submit

Summary: Admin Attendance Session Reopen & Amendment Workflow
Description: Enable school administrators to reopen or amend a submitted attendance session with mandatory audit reason logging when a teacher makes an erroneous mark.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a submitted attendance session, WHEN an admin clicks 'Reopen Session' with a valid reason, THEN the session status reverts to 'open', teacher is notified, and an audit log is recorded.

Summary: Structured Absence Taxonomy with Detail Description Input
Description: Implement categorized absence reason selection (Medical, Family Emergency, Official Representation, Bereavement, Unexcused) combined with a mandatory detail description text input.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an absence or permission form, WHEN user selects an absence category, THEN category is recorded along with free-text detailed explanation and optional evidence.

Summary: Teacher 1-Click 'Mark All Present' & Quick Toggle Shortcuts
Description: Add a top-level bulk action button in the teacher roll-call interface allowing 1-click marking of all unlocked students as 'Present', with keyboard shortcuts (P for Present, A for Absent).
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an open attendance session with 40 students, WHEN teacher clicks 'Mark All Present', THEN all unlocked radio buttons switch to 'Present' in 1 click without affecting locked permission rows.

Summary: Interactive Confirmation Modal for Attendance Submission
Description: Replace native browser confirm alerts with a dedicated interactive confirmation modal that requires explicit teacher verification before freezing marks.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a teacher clicking 'Submit Attendance', WHEN the action triggers, THEN an interactive modal displays requiring explicit confirmation, with no auto-dismiss.

Summary: Complete Khmer (KH) & English (EN) Localization Wiring
Description: Wire the topbar language pill (KH | EN) to active session locale switching using Laravel translation files (lang/km.json and lang/en.json) across all views.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN any user clicking 'KH' or 'EN' on the topbar pill, WHEN switched, THEN the application updates the session locale and displays translated UI strings.

Summary: Inner View Vector Iconography Standardization
Description: Standardize all child views to pure Font Awesome 6 vector icons, removing all residual emojis from badges, table cells, and buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN any view in the system, WHEN inspected, THEN zero cartoon emojis are rendered, all icons use Font Awesome 6 classes.

Summary: Custom Date Range & Multi-Filter Report Generator
Description: Upgrade the reports module to support filtering by date range (From Date - To Date, Weekly, Monthly, Semester), Class, and Status.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN the admin reports dashboard, WHEN filtering by Date Range (e.g. Month of October) and Class (10A), THEN the summary metrics and detailed table reflect the scoped data.

Summary: Multi-Format Export: Excel (XLSX) & Printable PDF
Description: Provide export options for Excel (.xlsx) with styled headers and formula totals, as well as formal printable PDF reports suitable for ministry/board submissions.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN any filtered report view, WHEN clicking 'Export Excel' or 'Export PDF', THEN a formatted document downloads with school branding and term headers.

Summary: Eliminate Teacher Dashboard N+1 Query Inefficiency
Description: Refactor DashboardController::index for teachers to eager load today's attendance sessions and student counts using withCount and single-query grouping.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a teacher with 10 classes, WHEN loading the dashboard, THEN database query count remains constant at <= 4 queries instead of 24 queries.

Summary: Composite Database Indexing on Attendances Table
Description: Add composite database indexes on attendances table for ['final_status', 'finalized_at'] and ['attendance_session_id', 'status'] to optimize large reporting queries.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a database with 500,000 attendance records, WHEN querying weekly reports, THEN query execution completes in under 20ms using index scans.

Summary: Asynchronous Background Queue for Audit Logging
Description: Decouple AuditService::log from live database transaction commits by dispatching audit records to a Redis/database background queue.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a user performing any auditable action, WHEN processing completes, THEN audit logs are queued asynchronously without blocking HTTP response.

Summary: [ABORTED] Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP) for Administrators
Description: [ABORTED - Internal System Only] Implement Google Authenticator / TOTP time-based 2FA for Super Admin and Admin accounts. Cancelled as the system is deployed purely within school internal network.
Acceptance Criteria: N/A - Task aborted by project owner

Summary: Evidence File Upload Security & Malware / MIME Verification
Description: Implement strict MIME-type validation, size limits (max 5MB), and UUID-obfuscated storage for medical certificates and parent permission documents.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an evidence upload, WHEN an unpermitted file type (.exe, .html, .svg with scripts) is submitted, THEN it is rejected with a validation error.

Summary: 30-Minute Inactivity Auto-Timeout & Session Locking (All Users)
Description: Automated session logout after 30 minutes of inactivity for all authenticated users across all portals to safeguard unattended workstations.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an active user session, WHEN no user interaction occurs for 30 minutes, THEN the user is automatically logged out with a session expired notification.

Summary: Automated Telegram Bot & SMS Attendance Notifications
Description: Send instant automated Telegram or SMS notifications to parents when their child is recorded Absent or Late by Student Affairs.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a student marked Absent upon session submission, WHEN the background job runs, THEN the parent's linked Telegram chat receives a notification within 10 seconds.

Summary: [ABORTED] REST API with Laravel Sanctum for Mobile / Tablet Apps
Description: [ABORTED - Web-Only Architecture] REST API token infrastructure cancelled. Teachers will access the system directly via mobile web browser on smartphones/tablets, eliminating the need for a separate native mobile application.
Acceptance Criteria: N/A - Task aborted by project owner

Summary: EPIC: PSIS SIS Data Integration & Synchronization
Description: Student and classroom roster synchronization from PSIS School Management System via offline SQL backup file parsing or local restored database replica without live network dependencies.
Acceptance Criteria: Safe idempotent sync of active students, classrooms, and parent contact details without touching live remote database

Summary: Extend Student & Classroom Schema for PSIS Compatibility
Description: Add student_code, khmer_name, gender, dob, psis_student_id to students table and psis_group_id to classes table with safe indexing for idempotent synchronization.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN existing attendance records, WHEN migration executes, THEN student_code, khmer_name, gender, dob, and psis_id columns are added without data loss or breaking existing relations.

Summary: PSIS SQL Backup Stream Parser & Artisan Command (psis:import)
Description: Implement a memory-efficient stream parser and Artisan command (php artisan psis:import) to import active classes and students from db_psischv SQL backup or local restored MySQL replica.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a valid PSIS SQL backup file or local restored MySQL database, WHEN running php artisan psis:import, THEN all active classes and enrolled students for selected academic year are upserted cleanly.

Summary: Admin Web Portal PSIS Backup Upload & Sync UI
Description: Develop an intuitive Admin portal interface to upload new PSIS .sql backups, select academic year (e.g. 2026-2027), trigger synchronization, and view detailed import metrics.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an administrator with a new PSIS backup file, WHEN uploading via Admin UI and clicking Sync, THEN background job processes the file and displays an import summary.

Summary: Multi-Campus Tenancy & Data Isolation (CHV, KB, KSR, NR3)
Description: Implement multi-campus scoping on classes, students, and staff users across 4 campuses with topbar campus switcher for Super Admins.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN users from different campuses, WHEN accessing students or classes, THEN users only view data for their assigned campus, with Super Admin having cross-campus switching.

Summary: Login Route Rate Limiting (Brute-Force Protection)
Description: Add throttle middleware to POST /login to prevent unlimited password-guessing attempts. Apply Laravel built-in throttle:5,1 (5 attempts per minute per IP). No new packages required — uses Illuminate RateLimiter.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a user on the login page, WHEN 5 incorrect login attempts are made within 1 minute from the same IP, THEN the 6th attempt returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header and a user-friendly 'Too many attempts' message.

Summary: Hide Manual Create Student & Create Class Buttons from Admin UI
Description: Remove the '+ Add Student' and '+ Add Class' buttons from the admin index pages since roster data is now sourced from PSIS database sync. Keep backend routes, controllers, and create views intact as a hidden fallback for edge cases (e.g. transfer students not yet in PSIS — admin can navigate to /admin/students/create directly via URL).
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN the admin students index page, WHEN rendered, THEN no 'Add Student' button is visible. AND GIVEN the admin classes index page, WHEN rendered, THEN no 'Add Class' button is visible. AND GIVEN an admin who manually navigates to /admin/students/create, THEN the form still works as a fallback.

Summary: Remove Hardcoded Jira API Token from Sync Script
Description: scripts/sync_jira.ps1 line 4 contains a live Jira Cloud API token and email in plaintext default parameter values. Refactor the script to read credentials from environment variables ($env:JIRA_API_TOKEN, $env:JIRA_USER_EMAIL) and fail with a clear error if they are not set. Add scripts/ to .gitignore or add a .env.example pattern. The exposed token must be revoked immediately in Atlassian account settings.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN the sync_jira.ps1 script, WHEN inspected, THEN zero plaintext tokens or emails appear in the source code. AND GIVEN the script is run without $env:JIRA_API_TOKEN set, THEN it exits with a clear error message instructing the user to set the variable.

Summary: Campus-Scope the Audit Log Viewer for Admin Users
Description: AuditLogController::index() currently shows all audit logs system-wide regardless of admin campus. Every other admin listing (students, classes, permissions, reports) already filters by activeCampusId(). Add the same campus scoping by joining through attendance.student.campus_id or user.campus_id so campus-scoped admins only see their own campus activity. Super Admins retain full cross-campus visibility.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a campus-scoped admin (e.g. CHV campus), WHEN viewing the audit log, THEN only logs related to CHV students, classes, and users are shown. AND GIVEN a Super Admin, WHEN viewing the audit log, THEN all logs across all campuses are visible.

Summary: Increase Minimum Password Length from 6 to 8 Characters
Description: UserController store (line 71) and update (line 114) validate password with min:6. Update to min:8 to align with current security best practices for internal school accounts.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a Super Admin creating or editing a user, WHEN a password shorter than 8 characters is submitted, THEN a validation error is returned requiring at least 8 characters.

Summary: Log CacheService Tag-Flush Failures Instead of Silently Swallowing
Description: CacheService::invalidateDashboardStats() catches all Throwable exceptions silently in the cache tag flush block. Add Log::warning() in the catch so genuine failures (not just 'driver doesn't support tags') are surfaced in Laravel logs for debugging.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a real cache failure during tag flush, WHEN the exception is caught, THEN it is logged via Log::warning() with the exception message instead of being silently ignored.

Summary: Future-Proof Report Queries with DB-Level Aggregation & Pagination
Description: ReportController::index() and export() load full session+attendance collections into memory and sort in PHP. Fine at current school scale, but will need refactoring to DB-level aggregation (GROUP BY, SUM), cursor pagination, and chunked CSV streaming as data grows beyond one academic year. Tag as future optimization.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN 100,000+ attendance records across multiple semesters, WHEN generating a monthly report, THEN the query uses DB-level aggregation and does not load all records into PHP memory.

Summary: EPIC: Period Timetabling & Teacher Substitutions
Description: Support subject-based period timetables, multi-teacher classes, recurring weekly schedule templates, date-specific teacher substitutions, and primary period absence escalation.
Acceptance Criteria: Classes can support multiple periods per day with distinct teachers, substitutions, and scoped absence escalation.

Summary: Class Schedules, Substitutions & Attendance Session Schema
Description: Create class_schedules (id, class_id, day_of_week, period_number, subject, start_time, end_time, teacher_id, is_primary, is_active) and schedule_substitutions (id, class_schedule_id, session_date, original_teacher_id, substitute_teacher_id, reason, created_by). Alter attendance_sessions table to add class_schedule_id FK and adjust unique constraint to (class_schedule_id, session_date) while preserving legacy homeroom null compatibility.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN the new migrations, WHEN executed, THEN classes can have multiple attendance sessions on the same date for different periods without database unique key violations.

Summary: Schedule-Based Teacher Authorization & Primary Period Escalation
Description: Refactor Teacher AttendanceController::open() to resolve authorized teacher: check schedule_substitutions for (class_schedule_id, today) first, falling back to class_schedules.teacher_id. Introduce is_primary boolean flag on class_schedules so only the primary/morning roll-call triggers Student Affairs case escalation (Rule 7), preventing queue bloat for subsequent periods.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a schedule slot with an assigned teacher and an active substitution for today, WHEN the substitute teacher opens the session, THEN access is granted. AND GIVEN a student absent in period 2 (non-primary), THEN attendance is recorded but does not spawn a new Student Affairs escalation case.

Summary: Teacher Dashboard Today's Period Schedule View
Description: Refactor teacher dashboard to display today's assigned periods based on day_of_week and active substitutions rather than only homeroom class. Teachers see their schedule chronologically by period, start time, subject, and session status (Not Opened, Open, Submitted). Homeroom K1-K3 teachers seamlessly see 1 block; subject teachers see their 2-4 periods.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a secondary teacher teaching Math in 5A Period 1 and 6A Period 3, WHEN viewing the dashboard on Monday, THEN both periods appear chronologically with quick Open/Mark buttons.

Summary: Admin Timetable Bulk CSV Import & Timetable Management
Description: Implement an admin tool and artisan command (php artisan schedule:import) to bulk import class weekly timetables from CSV (class_name, day_of_week, period_number, subject, start_time, end_time, teacher_email, is_primary) to eliminate manual entry across 20-30 classes.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a school weekly timetable CSV with 200 period slots across 25 classes, WHEN imported, THEN all schedules are validated, mapped to classes and teachers, and populated cleanly.

Summary: Admin Date-Specific Quick Teacher Substitution Action
Description: Build an admin action/modal to quickly substitute a teacher for a specific schedule slot on a specific date (e.g. Teacher Chem is sick on Friday -> assign Teacher Dara for Period 2 Math). Automatically adjusts dashboard and permissions without altering the master timetable.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an admin selecting a class schedule slot for a date, WHEN assigning a substitute with a reason, THEN the substitution record is saved, audit-logged, and the substitute teacher is authorized to open and mark that session.

Epic Name: Quality Assurance, Automated Unit & End-to-End Testing
Summary: EPIC: Quality Assurance, Automated Unit & End-to-End Testing
Description: Comprehensive testing infrastructure covering isolated unit tests for core domain services, automated headless browser QA testing for UI/JavaScript workflows, and multi-role smoke regression testing.
Acceptance Criteria: High test coverage across Unit, Integration (Feature), and QA Browser layers with zero manual regression overhead.

Epic Link: Quality Assurance, Automated Unit & End-to-End Testing
Summary: Core Domain Services & Logic Unit Test Suite (tests/Unit)
Description: Build fast, isolated unit tests under tests/Unit without database or HTTP booting to test pure business logic: AttendanceService status transitions, PsisSyncService SQL stream line parser and record extraction, Permission date math and category constraints, and User/Student model helper methods.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN core service methods in AttendanceService and PsisSyncService, WHEN unit tests execute via phpunit --testsuite=Unit, THEN all edge cases and parsing rules pass in under 500ms with zero DB dependencies.

Epic Link: Quality Assurance, Automated Unit & End-to-End Testing
Summary: Automated Headless Browser QA & E2E Testing (Laravel Dusk)
Description: Setup automated browser QA testing (Laravel Dusk) to verify client-side JavaScript interactions: Teacher 1-click 'Mark All Present', interactive submit modal with student count validation, 30-minute idle inactivity auto-logout countdown, and Khmer/English locale switching.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN a headless browser session, WHEN a teacher marks roll-call, clicks 'Submit', and interacts with the confirmation modal, THEN client-side JS executes cleanly and asserts submission locks without browser errors.

Epic Link: Quality Assurance, Automated Unit & End-to-End Testing
Summary: Full-Cycle Multi-Role QA Smoke & Regression Test Suite
Description: Create an automated QA smoke test suite (php artisan test:smoke or dedicated Feature suite) executing an entire school day lifecycle across 5 roles: Super Admin creates user -> Admin syncs PSIS classes -> Teacher marks attendance -> Student Affairs resolves late arrival -> Admin reviews absence report -> Parent views record.
Acceptance Criteria: GIVEN an empty database, WHEN running the QA smoke test command, THEN the full multi-role school attendance lifecycle completes end-to-end with green assertions across all role boundaries.
